When the mat is finished.
The Door, Mat, and Immediate Floor in the Entryway. Catch grit, water and road salt at the threshold so none of it reaches the rest of the floors.

What done looks like:
1. A coarse mat outside the door
2. An absorbent one inside
3. Both lying dead flat with no curled corners
4. Nothing whatsoever on the floor inside the door's swing
